title: dierbachia breviflora

It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve skin health due to its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Dierbachia breviflora include anthraquinones, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
